name: musictex-studio
description: MusicTeX Studio — a MusixTeX (texlive-music) spectral-code production app with a macOS desktop-style UI (toolbar+LCD, library, inspector): spectral-code synthesizer (13 instruments + waves, harmonic sliders, five chord lines x 12 tones, live FFT), overlay import / timbre spectral-coding / chord-line extraction from song files, Mozart Vision (notes as visible-light wavelength bands, compose from a color keyboard), automatic transcription from song files (MIDI / audio), report-octave74 templates (B-flat/E-flat scales, G & A chords, HANON), live staff preview, Web Audio playback, and .tex export, as a self-contained HTML app
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
